summary: Responsive layout testing for pharmacy management app. Tested mobile (375px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1920px) viewports. All core responsive features work correctly: mobile hamburger menu, drawer navigation, desktop sidebar, breakpoint transitions. One design issue found: sync indicator overlaps with page title on mobile.

issues: Sync indicator 'Synchronisation des données...' overlaps with page title 'Tableau de bord' - the title appears as 'Tabl...rd' with middle part hidden
The sync indicator is positioned at top center and covers the dashboard title text
design_issues.suggestion: Move sync indicator below the mobile header (pt-16) or position it at bottom of screen, or add top margin to main content when sync is active

context_for_next_testing_agent: Responsive layout fully implemented and working. Mobile drawer menu, desktop sidebar, and breakpoint transitions all function correctly. Only issue is cosmetic: sync indicator overlaps with dashboard title on mobile. The 'Ouverture de Caisse' shift modal appears after login and can be dismissed with Escape key.

sync_indicator_overlap.root_cause: The sync indicator is positioned with 'fixed top-16 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 z-50' which places it at the top center, but the main content area on mobile has pt-16 padding which isn't enough to prevent overlap with the page title
sync_indicator_overlap.reproduction: Login on mobile viewport (375px), observe 'Synchronisation des données...' bubble overlapping with 'Tableau de bord' title
sync_indicator_overlap.mitigation: Either: 1) Increase top padding of main content when sync is active, 2) Move sync indicator to bottom of screen on mobile, or 3) Position sync indicator in the mobile header area
